title: OmniQuant AI - legit?
author: MrMezza
selftext:
Please remove if not allowed here, just looking for some guidance.

OmniQuant AI is an alleged quant trading system using AI bots, I found it through a Threads post that came up in my feed. Their website is accessible via the attached link. Does anybody know if this is legit or not? I can't find much about it online.

Their model is basically you pay a subscription fee to get access to their bot that you connect to your crypto exchange via an API and it does all the trading for you using the money you have in your account on your exchange.

Any info is much appreciated. TIA

comments.author: Shoddy_Peanut7320
comments.body: I haven't heard of it, so I can't say if it's legit. A few warning signs are worth checking: a name you can't find anywhere else, promises of returns, pushy ads on social media, and no verifiable track record or company details. If you ever connect any bot to an exchange, use a key with trade permission only and withdrawals turned off, so the worst case is limited. Also look for who runs it and whether they're registered with a regulator. If they can't show real, checkable results, I'd pass.

replies.author: MrMezza
replies.body:
Thank you. Yeah I’ll be cutting it off because the bot “requires” that all permissions be granted for it to work. I tried setting up the key with only trade perms and it throws an error saying required perms haven’t been allowed so I don’t think I’ll be going there.

Yeah other thing is I can’t find any info on who runs it or anything. Probably a scam. Thanks for your comment!

comments.author: QuanTradin
comments.body: first thing I'd check is what permissions the API key they want actually needs. if it asks for withdrawal rights, walk away right there. a subscription bot with no track record you can verify outside their own site is the usual shape of these.

replies.author: MrMezza
replies.body: Yep, it asks for exactly that. In fact it “requires” that ALL permissions be granted for the bot to work. I’ll be cutting it off right there haha, thanks for the insight

replies.author: QuanTradin
replies.body: all permissions is the tell. a bot that only places trades never needs transfer rights, so one asking for everything wants more than your trades. if you ever want to watch a bot run before trusting one, Quantradin is the practice-money app I made for that, quantradin.com
